hero.title: Local, practical, and accountable by design.
hero.lede: Lowcountry Digital Works is based in Beaufort, South Carolina. Clients work directly with Eddie on websites, workflows, digital ownership, and technical decisions that need to be useful without becoming unnecessarily complicated.

founder.name: Eddie Gugino
founder.title: One accountable point of contact from the first conversation through handoff.
founder.body: Eddie started Lowcountry Digital Works to help smaller organizations improve websites, workflows, and technical systems without forcing enterprise-sized complexity onto ordinary business problems. The working style is direct: understand the real need, use established tools where they fit, explain the tradeoffs, build only where a genuine gap remains, and leave ownership and handoff understandable.
founder.credentials: Eddie's background spans IT, cybersecurity, systems, and technical delivery, including service in the U.S. Navy. He holds the CISSP certification, a bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity from Utica College, and an Associate of Applied Science (AAS) in Network Systems Management from Midlands Technical College in Columbia, South Carolina.

principles.title: Lowcountry roots
principles.description: Local context matters, but the work is not restricted to one geography.

principles.title: Clear ownership
principles.description: Critical business assets should be held in the right owner accounts with named access, documented handoff, and a practical recovery path.

principles.title: Technology in proportion
principles.description: Native features, simple architectures, and maintained services are preferred when they solve the problem well. More infrastructure is added only when a real requirement justifies it.

principles.title: Work that can be explained
principles.description: Documentation, testing, security, accessibility, and understandable tradeoffs are treated as part of normal delivery quality.

whySmall.title: Small enough to stay direct. Disciplined enough to hand off cleanly.
whySmall.body: LDW is intentionally lean. The goal is not to imitate a large agency—it is to keep communication direct, choices explainable, recurring cost proportionate, and the customer's business assets in the right hands.
items: Work directly with the person responsible for the delivery
Use existing platforms and simple architectures when they fit
Document decisions, ownership, recovery, and rollback
Keep a clear path for handoff, ongoing care, or future growth

fit.title: Bring the real problem, even if you do not know the technical name for it.
fit.body: A useful first conversation can start with a website that is not doing its job, repetitive work that should be easier, disconnected tools, unclear ownership, or a technical decision that has become hard to untangle.
